title: Completed Qbar derived direct image over an arbitrary field
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k$, and $\Omega$ an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a finite-type $k$-morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the raw common-finite-stage categories $D^b_c(W,\Omega)$ of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], for $W=X,Y$, with the separated finite-type base convention retained by [lem-per-adic-heart-pullback-fibres]. The canonical completed pullback $Lf^*:D^b_c(Y,\Omega)\to D^b_c(X,\Omega)$ of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] has a right adjoint. Define $Rf_*:D^b_c(X,\Omega)\to D^b_c(Y,\Omega)$ to be that right adjoint, determined up to the unique adjunction-compatible isomorphism. It is the completed derived direct image of [def-weil-derived-direct-image]: derive finite-level module direct image by K-injective resolutions, apply restriction of scalars and the derived inverse limit to the finite-reduction tower, rationalize, and pass to common finite coefficient stages. The adjunction characterizes this construction; it does not choose an unrelated functor.
